Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Beyond the Line
Cards.Text: Battle: Take an additional action to use a Limited or Open Recon ability as a Battle action, which must target the current battlefield's province. If you do, draw a card after the action's resolution.

Cards.Name: One Action, Two Strikes
Cards.Text: Battle: If the enemy leader has taken any Battle actions during this battle: You may take two additional Battle actions after this one. You will not take any other additional Battle actions this battle.

Cards.Name: String of Victories
Cards.Text: Battle/Open: Straighten all of your Rings. You may put a Ring in your Fate discard pile into your hand. You may take an additional action appropriate to this phase.
